message.content: Based on the discussion, Dyllan provides insight into the combat mechanics in "Horizon Forbidden West." Specifically, Dyllan mentions that the combat can be challenging, particularly when dealing with flying machines. To handle these aerial threats effectively, Dyllan suggests using a bow equipped with elemental arrows, which can stun the flying machines and make them easier to defeat. Additionally, Dyllan recommends utilizing the player's focus ability to track the movements of the flying enemies, which aids in evading their attacks. This description indicates that the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" involves strategic elements and requires careful consideration of both weapon selection and player movement.
